build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from config and input shape with configurable depth and normalization
create_ResNet: create a ResNet model with stem, stages, optional classification head, and feature output specification
create_BottleneckBlock: create a bottleneck residual block with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 conv layers and optional stride in 1x1 conv
create_BasicBlock: create a basic residual block with two 3x3 conv layers and projection shortcut for ResNet-18 and ResNet-34
create_DeformBottleneckBlock: create a deformable bottleneck block with modulated or standard deformable conv in the 3x3 layer
